name: Giant Coppermouth

items.name: Deep Breath
items.text: The giant coppermouth can hold its breath for 1 hour.

items.name: Greater Electrolocation
items.text: A giant coppermouth can sense minute electrical charges in living creatures, which it can use as a precise sense at a range of 20 feet. This distance increases to 100 feet against any creature that has used an electricity effect within the last minute.

items.name: Coppermouth Venom
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 25 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d6 poison and 1d6 electricity (1 round)

Stage 2 2d6 poison and 1d6 electricity and Clumsy 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 2d6 poison and 2d6 electricity and Clumsy 2

items.name: Quickening Jolt
items.text: The coppermouth manipulates its own nervous system by increasing its reaction time, Striding and making two Strikes against different targets during the movement. Both attacks count toward its multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after it has made both attacks.

items.name: Venomous Spit
items.text: The coppermouth unleashes a stream of electrified venom in a 30-foot line. The venom deals 8d6 electricity damage (DC 22 basic Reflex save) and creatures that take damage from the venom are immediately exposed to coppermouth venom. The copper mouth can't use Venomous Spit again for 1d4 rounds.

text: Coppermouths are fierce and aggressive, even when alone, relying on their venom and ability to manipulate bioelectric impulses.
